summary: Tested Tsuki Restaurant API (backend) and admin + customer UI flows (frontend). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed covering auth, menu CRUD, tables CRUD with duplicate guard, order creation/active/add-items/pay (cashier & qris)/list. Frontend: admin login (pre-filled creds), Reservations dashboard with stats + orders table, Menu Management page, Tables Management page (QR dialog opens with download), customer /menu fallback, /menu?table=1 hero with 'Table #1 · Irasshaimase', add-to-cart, cart FAB, place order, active-order-banner, payment dialog (cashier + QRIS confirm) all reachable and functional.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby — accessibility warning in console (non-blocking)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription / aria-describedby on Dialog modals (cart drawer, payment dialog, QR dialog) to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider lifespan context manager.
POST /api/orders, /api/orders/{id}/items, /api/orders/{id}/pay are public — acceptable per spec (customer flow w/o auth) but consider rate-limiting in production.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — fine for preview, must restrict origins for production.
Backend correctly excludes Mongo _id via projections; password_hash also excluded. Good.
JWT_SECRET is read from env (good). Token lifetime 12h is acceptable for admin tool.
test_credentials: admin@restaurant.jp / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md, seeded by backend on startup)
seed_data_creation: Backend startup auto-seeds: 1 admin user, 7 menu items across 4 categories, 6 tables (1-6). Tests create temporary TEST_ menu items & ephemeral table numbers (9000+) and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_restaurant_api.py is reusable as regression. Frontend testids confirmed working: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, reservations-page, menu-add-button, add-table-submit, customer-menu-page, add-to-cart-<id>, cart-fab, place-order-button, open-payment-button, pay-cashier-button, pay-qris-button, qris-confirm-button. Note: thank-you screen substring detection failed in script but underlying API confirmed paid status — likely UI displays Japanese characters / different wording; not a bug. QR dialog opens on table-qr-<id> click; qr-download present.
